slide1.headline: Banks Warned of AI Security Risks
slide1.subtitle: Regulators caution about potential threats from Anthropic's Mythos AI

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: On 10 Apr 2026, regulators warned banks about security risks from Anthropic's Mythos AI.
The warning was issued by Powell and Bessent, citing potential threats to the banking system.
No specific numbers were given, but the warning highlights the growing concern about AI security risks.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The warning underscores the need for banks to be vigilant about AI security risks.
As AI becomes more prevalent in the financial sector, the potential for security breaches grows.
Banks must invest in robust security measures to protect themselves and their customers.

posts.caption: Regulators are warning banks about the potential security risks of AI, specifically Anthropic's Mythos AI. This highlights the growing concern about AI security risks in the financial sector. Questions to consider: What are the potential consequences of an AI security breach in the banking system? slide1.headline: EU AI Act Compliance Deadline Approaches
slide1.subtitle: Companies must prepare for the 2026 deadline

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: The EU AI Act sets a deadline of 2026 for companies to comply with new regulations.
The regulations aim to ensure that AI systems are safe and transparent.
Companies must conduct technical audits to ensure compliance, which may require significant investments, with some estimates suggesting costs in the hundreds of millions of euros.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The EU AI Act has significant implications for companies operating in the EU.
Non-compliance can result in fines of up to €30 million or 6% of global turnover.
Companies must prioritize compliance to avoid these penalties.

posts.caption: The EU AI Act deadline is approaching, and companies must prepare to comply with the new regulations. This requires significant investments in technical audits and compliance measures. Questions to consider: What are the key requirements of the EU AI Act? How can companies ensure compliance? #EUAIAct #compliance #regulation #AI #technology #2026deadline

slide1.headline: Chinese Startup Raises $293 Million for AI Development
slide1.subtitle: ShengShu aims to advance artificial general intelligence

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: On 10 Apr 2026, Chinese startup ShengShu raised $293 million in funding.
The funding will be used to advance artificial general intelligence.
This investment highlights the growing interest in AI development, with some $10 billion invested in AI startups in the past year alone.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The funding will help ShengShu develop more advanced AI systems.
Artificial general intelligence has the potential to transform numerous industries.
The investment in ShengShu demonstrates the confidence of investors in the potential of AI.

slide4.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The funding is a significant boost to the AI development sector.
It highlights the growing interest in AI development, with many startups receiving substantial investments.
